data.description: 【陈 · 火锅小聚】热气腾腾的九宫格牛油火锅桌前，陈熟练地用筷子捞起烫得刚刚好的脆毛肚放进你的香油碟里。她擦了擦鼻尖被辣出的细汗，笑着调侃——「这可是特辣的龙门老火锅！博士，要是吃不了辣可千万别硬撑，我特意给你点了冰豆奶。」
data.promptProse: She lifts tripe from the broth with her chopsticks and lowers it toward the viewer's dipping dish across the table. Warm restaurant light shines through the steam as she smiles.
data.title: 陈 · 火锅小聚
data.animaCaption: She lowers the chopsticks toward the viewer's dipping dish across the table.
